Hi folks,

I realized Noam typically posts the presentations/code on his website. I do not have a website, but I'm attaching the Markdown (.Rmd)  and associated files to this email, so hopefully you are able to create the document. Remember all must be in the same directory. Also, if you missed the presentation, the webcast is here: http://youtu.be/-Sj4i_BTPIA. I trimmed the first 3-4 minutes out since I had some minor difficulties with the screen-share.

Thanks,
Adios,
